proposals.before: Lang Tan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of Grand Secretary Wu Bai.
proposals.after: Lang Tan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of Minister of the Imperial Household Wu Bai.
proposals.reason: 內大臣 is the Minister of the Imperial Household (chamberlain), not Grand Secretary (大學士).

proposals.before: Lang Tan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of Grand Secretary Wu Bai.
proposals.after: Lang Tan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of Minister of the Imperial Household Wu Bai.
proposals.reason: Same 內大臣 mistranslation as Grand Secretary in the literal English.

proposals.before: In Shunzhi 8 (1651), when Wu Bai was condemned for siding with Grand Secretary Losi and others, Lang Tan was stripped of his post as well.
proposals.after: In Shunzhi 8 (1651), when Wu Bai was condemned for siding with Minister of the Imperial Household Losi and others, Lang Tan was stripped of his post as well.
proposals.reason: 內大臣洛什 should not be rendered Grand Secretary.

proposals.before: In Kangxi 28 (1689) Grand Secretary Songgotu met Russian envoys led by Fyodor at Nerchinsk to fix the border; Lang Tan joined the talks, after which the Russian posts were dismantled and the garrisons withdrawn.
proposals.after: In Kangxi 28 (1689) Minister of the Imperial Household Songgotu met Russian envoys led by Fyodor at Nerchinsk to fix the border; Lang Tan joined the talks, after which the Russian posts were dismantled and the garrisons withdrawn.
proposals.reason: 內大臣索額圖 is not Grand Secretary; use Minister of the Imperial Household.

proposals.before: He was soon made chief commandant of the imperial bodyguards and grand secretary, superintendent of the Firearms Brigade, and a grand councillor.
proposals.after: He was soon made chief commandant of the imperial bodyguards (ling shiwei nei dachen), superintendent of the Firearms Brigade, and a grand councillor.
proposals.reason: 領侍衛內大臣 is a single office, not bodyguard commandant plus a separate grand secretary.

proposals.before: He retained his posts as chief bodyguard commandant, grand secretary, and grand councillor.
proposals.after: He retained his posts as chief commandant of the imperial bodyguards and grand councillor.
proposals.reason: 領侍衛內大臣 is one office; remove the spurious grand secretary.

proposals.before: Peng Chun, of the Donggo clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of Hešeri.
proposals.after: Peng Chun, of the Donggo clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of He Heli.
proposals.reason: 何和禮 is He Heli (Hohoheli), not the Hešeri (赫舍里) clan name.

proposals.before: Peng Chun, of the Donggo clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of Hešeri.
proposals.after: Peng Chun, of the Donggo clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of He Heli.
proposals.reason: Same Hešeri mistranslation of 何和禮 in the literal English.

proposals.before: Hešeri's son Heshotu was raised to third-rank duke;
proposals.after: He Heli's son Heshotu was raised to third-rank duke;
proposals.reason: 何和禮 should be He Heli, not Hešeri.

proposals.before: His son Zengshou inherited as third-rank duke.
proposals.after: His son Zengshou succeeded by a change of inheritance as third-rank duke.
proposals.reason: Chinese 改襲 means the hereditary rank was altered, not simple unchanged succession.

proposals.before: In Kangxi 16 (1677) the Kangxi Emperor sent Grand Secretary Aisin Gioro Wumuna and others to worship at Mount Changbai; at Jilin they needed a guide who knew the way.
proposals.after: In Kangxi 16 (1677) the Kangxi Emperor sent Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Aisin Gioro Wumuna and others to worship at Mount Changbai; at Jilin they needed a guide who knew the way.
proposals.reason: 內大臣 is Grand Minister of the Imperial Household, not Grand Secretary (大學士).

proposals.before: In the sixteenth year of Kangxi the Sacred Ancestor sent Grand Secretary Aisin Gioro Wumuna and others to pay homage at Mount Changbai; when they reached Jilin they wished to find someone who knew the route to guide them.
proposals.after: In the sixteenth year of Kangxi the Sacred Ancestor sent Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Aisin Gioro Wumuna and others to pay homage at Mount Changbai; when they reached Jilin they wished to find someone who knew the route to guide them.
proposals.reason: 內大臣 is mistranslated as Grand Secretary.

proposals.before: In Kangxi 28 (1689), when Russian envoys led by Fyodor reached Nerchinsk, Grand Secretary Songgotu was sent to meet them with fifteen hundred Heilongjiang troops as guard.
proposals.after: In Kangxi 28 (1689), when Russian envoys led by Fyodor reached Nerchinsk, Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Songgotu was sent to meet them with fifteen hundred Heilongjiang troops as guard.
proposals.reason: 內大臣索額圖 is Grand Minister of the Imperial Household, not Grand Secretary.

proposals.before: In the twenty-eighth year the Russian envoys Feodor and others arrived at Nerchinsk; Grand Secretary Songgotu and others were ordered to meet them, and fifteen hundred Heilongjiang troops were sent as escort.
proposals.after: In the twenty-eighth year the Russian envoys Feodor and others arrived at Nerchinsk; Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Songgotu and others were ordered to meet them, and fifteen hundred Heilongjiang troops were sent as escort.
proposals.reason: 內大臣 is mistranslated as Grand Secretary.

proposals.before: In Kangxi 29 (1690) Sa Bu Su came to court, received lavish gifts, and was seated in the grand secretary rank.
proposals.after: In Kangxi 29 (1690) Sa Bu Su came to court, received lavish gifts, and was seated in the rank of the Grand Ministers of the Imperial Household.
proposals.reason: 內大臣班 is the Imperial Household chamberlain seating rank, not grand secretary rank.

proposals.before: In the twenty-ninth year Sa Bu Su came to audience; generous gifts were bestowed and he was ordered to sit in the grand secretary rank.
proposals.after: In the twenty-ninth year Sa Bu Su came to audience; generous gifts were bestowed and he was ordered to sit in the rank of the Grand Ministers of the Imperial Household.
proposals.reason: 內大臣班 does not mean grand secretary rank.

proposals.before: In Kangxi 35 (1696) the emperor campaigned in person from Dushikou on the center route while Grand General Fiyanggū marched from Guihua on the west; Sa Bu Su was to block the east with Shengjing, Ningguta, and Khorchin troops advancing from Suoyorji Mountain on schedule.
proposals.after: In Kangxi 35 (1696) the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan from Dushikou on the center route while Grand General Fiyanggū marched from Guihua on the west; Sa Bu Su was to block the east with Shengjing, Ningguta, and Khorchin troops advancing from Suoyorji Mountain on schedule.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English omits 噶爾丹, the stated campaign target present in the Chinese and literal.

proposals.before: With Grand Secretary Kadai he proclaimed imperial prohibitions to the outer Khorchin banners.
proposals.after: With Inner Minister Kadai he proclaimed imperial prohibitions to the outer Khorchin banners.
proposals.reason: 內大臣 is Inner Minister / Grand Minister of the Household, not Grand Secretary (大學士).

proposals.before: Together with Grand Secretary Kadai he went to the outer Khorchin vassals to proclaim prohibitions.
proposals.after: Together with Inner Minister Kadai he went to the outer Khorchin vassals to proclaim prohibitions.
proposals.reason: 內大臣 is Inner Minister / Grand Minister of the Household, not Grand Secretary (大學士).

proposals.before: The emperor recalled that Sa Bu Su had once urged removing Governor Cai Yurong from the twelve forts and that the change had worked well;
proposals.after: The emperor recalled that Sa Bu Su had once memorialized to dismiss Governor Cai Yurong from managing the twelve forts and that the change had worked well;
proposals.reason: 革任…經理 means dismiss from the managing post, not merely remove him from the forts as a place.

proposals.before: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan raided the Khalkha; Ma La was ordered, together with Lieutenant-General Ehena, Vanguard Commander Shuonai, and others, to lead troops against him and was granted an imperial groom and horse for the journey.
proposals.after: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan raided the Khalkha; Ma La was ordered, together with Lieutenant-General Ehena, Vanguard Commander Shuonai, and others, to lead troops against him and was granted horses from the imperial stables for the journey.
proposals.reason: 內廝馬 means horses from the imperial stables (內廝), not an imperial groom plus a horse.

proposals.before: In Kangxi 32 (1693) Dzungar Khoshut taiji Batur Erkejin surrendered; the emperor distrusted them and ordered Ma La to move them inland and prevent escape.
proposals.after: In Kangxi 32 (1693) Dzungar Khoshut taiji Batur Erkejin came to surrender; the emperor considered his people not yet trustworthy and ordered Ma La to move them inland and prevent escape.
proposals.reason: Chinese 來降 and 其人未可信 refer to Batur coming to surrender and his people not yet being trustworthy; idiomatic collapses this and pluralizes distrust without the people nuance.

decisions.reason: s0003 has 內大臣吳拜子; 內大臣 is the Imperial Household chamberlain office, not Grand Secretary (大學士). The proposed replacement correctly restores the office title.
The literal likewise renders 內大臣 as Grand Secretary; Minister of the Imperial Household matches the Chinese office.
s0009 has 附和內大臣洛什等; Losi’s title is 內大臣, not Grand Secretary. The replacement corrects the office.
s0057 has 內大臣索額圖; Songgotu’s title here is 內大臣, not Grand Secretary. The proposed office is accurate.
s0061 has 領侍衛內大臣 as one office, then 兼火器營總管 and 列議政大臣. The original invents a separate grand secretary; the proposal restores the unitary office.
s0065 has 仍任領侍衛內大臣，列議政如故—two posts only. Removing the spurious grand secretary matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 仍任領侍衛內大臣，列議政如故

decisions.reason: s0068 has 何和禮四世孫; 何和禮 is the personal name He Heli, not the clan name Hešeri (赫舍里). The replacement restores the correct name.
The literal repeats the same misidentification of 何和禮 as Hešeri; He Heli is the correct personal name.
s0069 opens 何和禮子和碩圖; the father is He Heli, not Hešeri. The proposed possessive corrects the name.

decisions.after: His son Zengshou succeeded by altered inheritance as third-rank duke.
decisions.reason: s0096 has 改襲三等公; 改襲 marks an altered hereditary succession, so plain 'inherited' is wrong. The proposal’s sense is right, but 'a change of inheritance' is awkward; 'succeeded by altered inheritance' is clearer.
s0101 has 遣內大臣覺羅武默訥; Wumuna’s title is 內大臣, not Grand Secretary. Grand Minister of the Imperial Household is accurate.
The literal likewise mistranslates 內大臣 as Grand Secretary; the proposed office title matches the Chinese.
s0126 has 命內大臣索額圖等往會; Songgotu is 內大臣 here, not Grand Secretary. The replacement corrects the office.
The literal repeats Grand Secretary for 內大臣索額圖; Grand Minister of the Imperial Household is the correct title.
s0128 has 命坐內大臣班; 內大臣班 is the seating rank of the Imperial Household ministers, not grand secretaries. The proposal restores that sense.
The literal likewise calls 內大臣班 the grand secretary rank; the proposed seating phrasing matches the Chinese.
s0136 has 上親征噶爾丹; the idiomatic omits the campaign target 噶爾丹. Adding 'against Galdan' restores information present in the Chinese.
s0162 has 偕內大臣喀岱; Kadai’s title is 內大臣, not Grand Secretary. Inner Minister correctly rejects the wrong office.
The literal likewise renders 內大臣喀岱 as Grand Secretary; Inner Minister matches the Chinese office.
s0146 has 革任總督蔡毓榮經理十二堡; 革任…經理 means dismissal from managing the twelve forts, not mere removal from a place. The proposal restores that sense.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 革任總督蔡毓榮經理十二堡

decisions.reason: s0180 ends 賜內廝馬以行; 內廝 is the imperial stables and 馬 the horses. Reading 廝 as 'groom' invents a person; 'horses from the imperial stables' is correct.
s0186 has 來降 and 其人未可信: Batur came to surrender, and the emperor judged his people not yet trustworthy. The proposal restores both nuances lost in the collapsed original.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0007 shows English Hešeri came only from confusing 何和禮 with the clan name 赫舍里; the personal-name claim remains, but en must read He Heli while zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence stay the same.

Accepted r0018 shows the title claim English 'Grand Secretary Kadai' was created solely by mistranslating 內大臣 as Grand Secretary; the title fact remains, but en must read Inner Minister Kadai to match the Chinese and the accepted repair.
